ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / Canvas Cyclone) DLL sideload via Symantec / McAfee / Google updater binaries from non-canonical paths
ucs.description: Hunts the OceanLotus tradecraft of co-locating a legitimately signed AV / updater host binary (wsc_proxy.exe, mcoemcpy.exe, GoogleUpdate.exe, rastlsc.exe, etc.) alongside a malicious DLL of the expected name (wsc.dll, mcutil.dll, goopdate.dll, rastls.dll) inside ProgramData / AppData / Temp — the trademark sideloading chain documented across Cobalt Kitty (Cybereason), KerrDown / Roland (Volexity) and ESET OceanLotus reporting. Fires when one of the known host binaries loads one of the known sideload-target DLLs from outside the canonical Program Files / System32 install roots, or when the host
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="wsc_proxy.exe" OR Processes.process_name="wsc.exe" OR Processes.process_name="mcoemcpy.exe" OR Processes.process_name="mcsvhost.exe" OR Processes.process_name="mcvsmap.exe" OR Processes.process_name="GoogleUpdate.exe" OR Processes.process_name="rast.exe" OR Processes.process_name="rastlsc.exe" OR Processes.process_name="navlogon.exe" OR Processes.process_name="symerr.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval process_path_lower=lower(process_path) | where NOT (match(process_path_lower, "^c:\\\\program files") OR match(process_path_lower, "^c:\\\\windows\\\\system32") OR match(process_path_lower, "^c:\\\\windows\\\\syswow64")) | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort -lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let OceanLotusHosts = dynamic(["wsc_proxy.exe","wsc.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcsvhost.exe","mcvsmap.exe","googleupdate.exe","rast.exe","rastlsc.exe","navlogon.exe","symerr.exe"]);
let OceanLotusDlls = dynamic(["wsc.dll","goopdate.dll","mcutil.dll","rastls.dll","navlogon.dll","symneti.dll"]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OceanLotusHosts)
| where FileName in~ (OceanLotusDlls)
| extend HostPathLower = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
| extend DllPathLower  = tolower(FolderPath)
| extend HostUnderProgramFiles = HostPathLower startswith @"c:\program files"
| extend DllUnderProgramFiles  = DllPathLower  startswith @"c:\program files" or DllPathLower startswith @"c:\windows\system32" or DllPathLower startswith @"c:\windows\syswow64"
| where not(HostUnderProgramFiles) or not(DllUnderProgramFiles)   // sideload anomaly: host or DLL outside trusted roots
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          HostBinary  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          HostPath    = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          HostCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          HostSHA256  = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          LoadedDll   = FileName,
          DllPath     = FolderPath,
          DllSHA256   = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let OceanLotusHostEndings = dynamic([@"\wsc_proxy.exe", @"\wsc.exe", @"\mcoemcpy.exe", @"\mcsvhost.exe", @"\mcvsmap.exe", @"\googleupdate.exe", @"\rast.exe", @"\rastlsc.exe", @"\navlogon.exe", @"\symerr.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend NewProcessNameLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where NewProcessNameLower has_any (OceanLotusHostEndings)
| where not(NewProcessNameLower startswith @"c:\program files") and not(NewProcessNameLower startswith @"c:\windows\system32") and not(NewProcessNameLower startswith @"c:\windows\syswow64")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer,
          AccountName   = SubjectUserName,
          NewProcessName,
          CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessId,
          LogonId = SubjectLogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 (OceanLotus) Sideload Host Binary Running From Non-Canonical Path
id: 9c5e9f3a-3b41-4a8d-9d2c-a1e6b8d6e510
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of OceanLotus-favoured DLL-sideload host binaries (Symantec, McAfee, Google Updater) from outside their canonical Program Files / System32 install roots — a high-fidelity APT32 sideloading indicator (Cobalt Kitty, KerrDown, Roland).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1574/002/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_bin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\wsc.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\mcsvhost.exe'
      - '\mcvsmap.exe'
      - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
      - '\rast.exe'
      - '\rastlsc.exe'
      - '\navlogon.exe'
      - '\symerr.exe'
  filter_path:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
  condition: selection_bin and not filter_path
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Symantec/McAfee/Google installers staged temporarily by SCCM/Intune (whitelist by deployment-tool parent)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\\wsc.exe OR *\\WSC.EXE OR *\\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\\MCOEMCPY.EXE OR *\\mcsvhost.exe OR *\\mcvsmap.exe OR *\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\\GOOGLEUPDATE.EXE OR *\\rast.exe OR *\\rastlsc.exe OR *\\navlogon.exe OR *\\symerr.exe) NOT @Image:(*\\Program?Files\\* OR *\\Program?Files?\(x86\)\\* OR *\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(wsc_proxy|wsc|mcoemcpy|mcsvhost|mcvsmap|googleupdate|rast|rastlsc|navlogon|symerr)\.exe$/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/^C:\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/^C:\\Windows\\(System32|SysWOW64)\\/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / BISMUTH) Outlook persistence via VbaProject.OTM modification by non-Outlook process
ucs.description: Hunts the OceanLotus Outlook-macro persistence technique repeatedly documented against Vietnamese diaspora, dissident, and Southeast-Asian government targets: writing a weaponised VbaProject.OTM into %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Outlook\ so that every Outlook launch executes attacker VBA. Detection fires when any process other than Outlook itself creates or modifies VbaProject.OTM under the Outlook profile directory — a near-zero-noise signal in production environments.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="VbaProject.OTM" Filesystem.file_path="*\\Microsoft\\Outlook\\*" (Filesystem.action=created OR Filesystem.action=modified OR Filesystem.action=write) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | eval process_name_lower=lower(process_name) | where NOT (process_name_lower="outlook.exe") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort -lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| where FileName =~ "VbaProject.OTM"
| where FolderPath has @"\Microsoft\Outlook\"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("outlook.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AccountName   = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          WriterProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          WriterPath    = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          WriterCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          TargetFile    = strcat(FolderPath, FileName),
          OtmSHA256     = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where TargetFileName =~ "VbaProject.OTM"
| where TargetFilePath has @"\Microsoft\Outlook\"
| extend ActingLower = tolower(ActingProcessName)
| where not(ActingLower endswith @"\outlook.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated,
          DvcHostname,
          ActorUsername,
          WriterProcess = ActingProcessName,
          WriterCmd     = ActingProcessCommandLine,
          TargetFile    = TargetFilePath,
          OtmSHA256     = TargetFileSHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 (OceanLotus) Outlook Persistence via VbaProject.OTM Modification
id: 7b1c9d22-4f10-4e3a-bf6e-2d4b8a1c0fa2
status: experimental
description: Detects creation or modification of VbaProject.OTM (Outlook macros template) under the Outlook profile directory by any process other than outlook.exe — the signature OceanLotus persistence technique documented by Volexity and Mandiant against Vietnamese diaspora and SE-Asian government targets.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1137/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1137
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\Microsoft\Outlook\VbaProject.OTM'
  filter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\outlook.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
falsepositives:
  - Enterprise Outlook macro deployment via SCCM / Intune / GPO logon scripts (whitelist deployment process)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\Microsoft\\Outlook\\VbaProject.OTM OR *\\microsoft\\outlook\\vbaproject.otm OR *\\MICROSOFT\\OUTLOOK\\VBAPROJECT.OTM) NOT @Image:(*\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\Outlook.exe OR *\\outlook.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\Microsoft\\Outlook\\VbaProject\.OTM$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\outlook\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Volexity and Mandiant publicly attributed VbaProject.OTM-based Outlook persistence to APT32 in multiple 2019-2022 campaigns against Vietnamese activists, ASEAN officials, and Western think-tanks (operations 'Roland' and the Vietnamese-language phishing chain).
